sn34.46:1.2: Samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo hoti na samādhismim abhinīhārakusalo || ||
sn34.46:1.3: Samādhismim abhinīhārakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo || ||
sn34.46:1.4: Neva samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo hoti na samādhismim abhinīhārakusalo || ||
sn34.46:1.5: Samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo ca || || 9-10
sn34.46:1.6: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave gavā khīraṃ || khīramhā dadhi || dadimhā navanītaṃ || navanītamhā sappi || sappimhā sappimaṇḍo || tatra aggam akkhāyati ||
sn34.46:1.7: evam eva kho bhikkhave yvāyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo ca samādhismim abhinīhārakusalo ca ayam imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ || pa ||
